artifacts.title: Neighborhood Atlas — initial brief
artifacts.content: Build a practical map that helps residents find walking routes and local services. Make crossings and step-free access easy to understand.

artifacts.title: Route observations
artifacts.content: Compared walking routes, crossings, and access to nearby services. Several notes focus on making the safest path clear to a first-time visitor.

artifacts.title: Map layout sketches
artifacts.content: Early sketches prioritize route clarity and a compact neighborhood index. The page should help someone orient themselves quickly.

artifacts.title: Conversations with shopkeepers
artifacts.content: Collected short recollections from shopkeepers about how the neighborhood changed, who used to gather here, and what people remember about the old market.

artifacts.title: Stories beside the map
artifacts.content: A draft pairs resident stories with small location illustrations. The stories are beginning to lead each spread, with places providing context.

artifacts.title: Story-map prototype
artifacts.content: The prototype leads with recorded memories from long-time residents while retaining a route index for visitors. Navigation remains useful, but oral histories shape the experience.
